header.running_head: 5. Dhikr and Du'as Taught by the Prophet ﷺ...

blocks.tamil_translation: one makes Du'a and the others say Amin, Allah Ta'ala certainly accepts their Du'a,” narrates Hazrat Habib ibn Maslamah Fihri (RA) that Rasulullah ﷺ said.

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ زُهَيْرِنِ النُّمَيْرِيِّ ﵁ قَالَ: خَرَجْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللهِ ﷺ ذَاتَ لَيْلَةٍ فَأَتَيْنَا عَلَي رَجُلٍ قَدْ أَلَحَّ فِي الْمَسْئَلَةِ فَوَقَفَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ يَسْتَمِعُ مِنْهُ فَقَالَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ: أَوْجَبَ إِنْ خََتَمَ فَقَالَ رَجَلٌ مِنَ الْقَوْمِ: بِأَيِّ شَيْءٍ يَخْتِمُ فَقَالَ: بِآمِينَ فَإِنَّهُ إِنْ خَتَمَ بِآمِينَ فَقَدْ أَوْجَبَ فَانْصَرَفَ الرَّجُلُ الَّذِي سَأَلَ النَّبِيَّ ﷺ فَأَتي الرَّجُلَ فَقَال: اِخْتِمْ يَافُلَانُ بِآمِينَ وَأَبْشِرْ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب التامين وراء الامام رقم:٩٣٨
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Zuhair Numairi (RA) narrates: “One night we were going along with the Prophet ﷺ, and we passed by a man who was making Du'a with great humility and submission. The Prophet ﷺ stopped to listen to his Du'a and said, “If he puts a seal on his Du'a, he will have it accepted.' One of the people asked, “With what should he seal it?' The Prophet ﷺ said, “With Amin. Indeed, if he seals it with Amin (if he says Amin at the end of the Du'a), he will have made the acceptance of the Du'a binding.” Then the one who had asked the Prophet ﷺ about the seal went to the man (making Du'a) and said, “Conclude your Du'a with Amin!' “I give you the good news that the Du'a will be accepted.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَائِشَةَ ﵂ قَالَتْ: كَانَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ يَسْتَحِبُّ الْجَوَامِعَ مِنَ الدُّعَاءِ وَيَدَعُ مَاسِوَي ذلِكَ.
